COLORFUL_PHILOSOPHERS.pages.INITIAL.opti.note: Three card rewards from the defect pool: one of $Cards=3 Common cards, one of 3 Uncommon, one of 3 Rare (choose 1 from each; each reward skippable).

DARV.pages.INITIAL.options.CALLING_BELL.note: Also offers 3 relic rewards: one Common, one Uncommon, one Rare (fixed relics Anchor/GremlinHorn/MummifiedHand only in test mode).

DARV.pages.INITIAL.options.RUNIC_PYRAMID.note: Passive relic; no immediate effect on obtain.

DARV.pages.INITIAL.options.DUSTY_TOME.note: Adds 1 random upgraded Ancient-rarity card of the character pool to the deck (rolled at event generation).

ENDLESS_CONVEYOR.pages.ALL.options.CLAM_.requires: HP not full (else dish not offered)

ENDLESS_CONVEYOR.pages.ALL.options.GOLDE.requires: not offered on first dish (needs more than 1 grab)
ENDLESS_CONVEYOR.pages.ALL.options.GOLDE.note: Dish option (weight 1); FREE (no gold cost) and gives 75 gold.

FAKE_MERCHANT.note: No EventOption text keys: custom-layout shop. 6 of 9 fake relics (FAKE_ANCHOR, FAKE_BLOOD_VIAL, FAKE_HAPPY_FLOWER, FAKE_LEES_WAFFLE, FAKE_MANGO, FAKE_ORICHALCUM, FAKE_SNECKO_EYE, FAKE_STRIKE_DUMMY, FAKE_VENERABLE_TEA_SET) sold for 50 gold each. FIELD_OF_MAN_SIZED_HOLES.pages.INITIAL.o.note: Player picks 1 enchantable card. GoldVar 75 defined but unused by handlers.

HUNGRY_FOR_MUSHROOMS.pages.INITIAL.optio.note: Relic BigMushroom on obtain: +20 max HP (MaxHpVar); also reduces first hand draw by 2 (CardsVar).
Relic FragrantMushroom on obtain: 15 unblockable damage + upgrades 2 random upgradable cards.

INFESTED_AUTOMATON.pages.INITIAL.options.note: 1 random Power card from character pool added to deck (no choice).
1 random 0-cost (non-X) card from character pool added to deck (no choice).

JUNGLE_MAZE_ADVENTURE.pages.INITIAL.opti.note: SoloGold = 150 +/- up to 15 (random float, fixed at event generation); SoloHp 18 unblockable.
JoinForcesGold = 50 +/- up to 15 (fixed at generation). Shared event (multiplayer).

LUMINOUS_CHOIR.pages.INITIAL.options.OFF.note: Gold = 149 - rng(0..49), fixed at generation. Relic = next relic from pool front.

MORPHIC_GROVE.pages.INITIAL.options.GROU.note: All gold is stolen. Shared event.

MUSEUM_OF_TORTURE.pages.DISPLAY.options..note: Relic rolled uniformly among 3 when event is generated. Loses $MaxHp=10 max HP and gains a random curse card from the curse pool.

NEOW.note: Offers 3 options: 1 random curse-relic option plus 2 random positive options from the pool (pool gets one of LAVA_ROCK/SMALL_CAPSULE (unless LARGE_CAPSULE), one of NUTRITIOUS_OYSTER/STONE_HUMIDIFIER and one of NEOWS_TALISMAN/POMANDER added, with some exclusions per curse). Options filtered by IsAllowedAtNeow. With run modifiers, option keys are the modifier ids (dynamic, not enumerated); a BLITZ option exists in Blitz mode.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.HEFTY_TABLET.note: Curse option: choose 1 of 3 Rare character cards (skippable), plus Injury.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.LARGE_CAPSULE.note: Curse option: +2 relics and 1 extra basic Strike and 1 extra basic Defend of the character added to deck.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.LEAFY_POULTIC.note: Curse option: transforms 1 basic Strike and 1 basic Defend (auto-chosen).

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.NEOWS_BONES.note: Curse option: 2 relic rewards drawn from the other Neow relic options (cannot skip) and 1 random curse.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.SILKEN_TRESS.note: Curse option; passive: modifies card rewards.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.ARCANE_SCROLL.note: Positive: 1 random Rare character card (no upgrade roll) added to deck. Not offered with HEFTY_TABLET.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.BOOMING_CONCH.note: Passive relic; no immediate effect on obtain.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.KALEIDOSCOPE.note: Two card rewards each offering 3 cards (one from each of 3 other character pools); requires all character pools unlocked.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.LOST_COFFER.note: One card reward (3 cards) + one potion. Not offered with NEOWS_SACRIFICE.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.SCROLL_BOXES.note: Choose 1 bundle of cards from random bundles; all cards in the bundle are added.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.WINGED_BOOTS.note: Passive relic; no immediate effect on obtain.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.LAVA_ROCK.note: Passive (extra boss relics); offered 50% vs SMALL_CAPSULE, never with LARGE_CAPSULE.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.SMALL_CAPSULE.note: Offered 50% vs LAVA_ROCK; never with LARGE_CAPSULE.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.STONE_HUMIDIF.note: Passive: +5 max HP after each rest-site heal.

NEOW.pages.INITIAL.options.NEOWS_TALISMA.note: Upgrades the last basic Strike and last basic Defend in the deck. Offered 50% vs POMANDER.

NONUPEIPE.pages.INITIAL.options.DELICATE.note: Passive relic; no immediate effect on obtain.

NONUPEIPE.pages.INITIAL.options.DIAMOND_.note: Passive: 20 block at start of first turn.

NONUPEIPE.pages.INITIAL.options.GLITTER.note: Passive relic; no immediate effect on obtain.

NONUPEIPE.pages.INITIAL.options.BEAUTIFU.note: Enchants 4 random enchantable cards with Swift 2.

OROBAS.pages.INITIAL.options.PRISMATIC_G.note: Pool 1 (1/3 chance in place of SEA_GLASS). Passive: +1 energy.

OROBAS.pages.INITIAL.options.OPTION_POOL.requires: neither TOUCH_OF_OROBAS nor ARCHAIC_TOOTH is usable

PAEL.pages.INITIAL.options.PAELS_LEGION.note: Pool 3 (extra). Summons a pet in combat.

RANWID_THE_ELDER.pages.INITIAL.options.R.note: Dynamic title: gives up one randomly chosen tradable relic (chosen at generation); gets 2 relics from pool front.

RELIC_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.options.MIDDL.note: Same as TOP for the 2nd pair.

RELIC_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.options.BOTTO.note: Same as TOP for the 3rd pair.

ROOM_FULL_OF_CHEESE.pages.INITIAL.option.note: Choose 2 of 8 Common character cards, added to deck.

ROUND_TEA_PARTY.pages.PICK_FIGHT.options.note: Damage 11 unblockable; relic = next from pool front.

SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.INITIAL.options.NO_.note: Only shown if none of the three card types are enchantable.

SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.requires: total floor > 6 and every player has a removable card

SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.pages.INITIAL.options.HO.note: Damage = 3 + number of previous hold-ons (unblockable); rerolls the card to lose.

SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.pages.HOLD_ON_LOOP.optio.note: Loops forever; damage keeps growing by 1 each hold (11, 12, ...).

SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.pages.INITIAL.option.note: Heal = 33% of max HP ($Heal computed at generation).

STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.requires: act index == 1 (Act 2) and every player holds a potion

SUNKEN_STATUE.pages.INITIAL.options.DIVE.note: Gold = 111 + rng(-10..10) fixed at generation; HpLoss 7 unblockable.

TABLET_OF_TRUTH.pages.INITIAL.options.DE.note: Lose 3 max HP, upgrade 1 random upgradable card.

TABLET_OF_TRUTH.pages.DECIPHER.options.G.note: Leave after at least one decipher; shared textKey on pages DECIPHER_1..4.

TANX.pages.INITIAL.options.TRI_BOOMERANG.requires: at least 3 cards enchantable with INSTINCT

TEA_MASTER.requires: act index < 2 and every player gold >= 150

TEA_MASTER.pages.INITIAL.options.BONE_TE.note: Bone Tea: next combat upgrades the starting hand.

TEA_MASTER.pages.INITIAL.options.EMBER_T.note: Ember Tea: +2 Strength for next 5 combats.

TEA_MASTER.pages.INITIAL.options.TEA_OF_.note: Free; relic adds 2 Dazed to draw pile at start of next combat only (1 combat).

TEZCATARA.note: Offers 3 options, one from each of 3 pools.

TEZCATARA.pages.INITIAL.options.VERY_HOT.note: Pool 1. Passive: +4 energy on first turn.

TEZCATARA.pages.INITIAL.options.GOLDEN_C.note: Pool 3. Regenerates the act map with a golden path.

TEZCATARA.pages.INITIAL.options.TOY_BOX.note: Pool 3. Offers 5 wax relics as rewards.

THERMAE_NONUPEIPE.requires: gold > 175, HP <= 75% max HP, act ancient is not Nonupeipe

Bath Robes: full heal once before the boss fight.
31 unblockable damage, 3 Guilty. Relic = random one of Nonupeipe's possible relic options excluding LOOMING_FRUIT, rolled at generation (DrinkRelic).

THE_ARCHITECT.note: Dialogue-only event with no pages.*.options keys.

THE_ARCHITECT.dialogue.N.note: Dialogue-advance option (textKey THE_ARCHITECT.dialogue.<line index>); no effect.

PROCEED.note: Final option (textKey PROCEED): WinRun - ends the run as a victory.

THE_FUTURE_OF_POTIONS.pages.INITIAL.opti.note: Up to 3 such options (one per first-3 held potions, dynamic title). Trades that potion for a card reward: choose 1 of 3 UPGRADED character cards of a random type (Attack/Skill; Power also possible only for Uncommon+ potions) and rarity by potion rarity (Common/Token->Common, Uncommon->Uncommon, Rare/Event->Rare). THE_LANTERN_KEY.pages.KEEP_THE_KEY.optio.note: Reward is a special card reward (LANTERN_KEY) in addition to normal combat rewards.

Mad Science card of Power type; riders offered: 2 of EXPERTISE/CURIOUS/IMPROVEMENT.

TRASH_HEAP.pages.INITIAL.options.DIVE_IN.note: HpLoss 8 unblockable (applies in every outcome); relic uniformly one of 5.

TRASH_HEAP.pages.INITIAL.options.GRAB.note: Gold 100 (applies in every outcome); one random card of 10 added to deck.
